artifacts.summary: 5-phase, 5-hour plan covering three independent CI causes: the closureList name ambiguity, the masked lint-style failure, and the doc-gen4 OOM (re-diagnosed this dispatch).

memory_candidates.content: A CI failure summary naming which Lake TARGETS logged failures can misattribute an out-of-memory kill as a configuration fault. In BimodalLogic's API Documentation workflow, doc-gen4's failure summary listed 'Qq:srcUri.github', 'mathlib:srcUri.github' and siblings, which reads as a source-URI misconfiguration; the log body carried only 'error: resource exhausted (error code: 12, cannot allocate memory)' on every one of them. The srcUri facets fork a git subprocess, so they are the first targets to fail once memory is exhausted by concurrent doc-gen4 processes - they name the symptom, never the cause. The discriminating check is a tally of error CLASSES in the log body (gh run view ID --log-failed | grep -o 'error: [a-z ]*' | sort | uniq -c), not the target list in the 'Some required targets logged failures' summary. Corroborating evidence for a growth-driven OOM rather than a config regression: the workflow file and lean-toolchain unchanged across the green-to-red boundary, with library file count rising over the same window.
